tasks.instruction: Diagnostic only, do not modify any file. Read the full contents of src/memory-seal.ts and report, with exact line ranges: (1) the constant/path that names the seal file (e.g. SEAL_FILE, sealPath) and which directory it resolves under (memory/.seal.json) — check src/home.ts (memoryPaths) if needed for the base path; (2) the function that WRITES/updates the seal (e.g. sealFile) — quote its signature and line range; (3) the function that computes the content digest/hash used in the seal (e.g. digest/sealContent) — line range; (4) the function that DETECTS an out-of-band modification / divergence (e.g. checkSeal) — quote its logic and line range, including the SealStatus / DIVERGED_BODY meaning. Do not use write_file or run any mutating command. Only use read_file and search_code. Output plain factual findings with file:line citations, no speculation beyond what the code shows.
